No real recipe here, this is a "throw it together" meal for me. But the gist is that you cube the potatoes and boil them till Mostly done. For roughly 1/2" sized cubes, that's 9~10 minutes on boil. Drain the water and toss them back in the hot pan as it'll evaporate more water. I walked away for 30 minutes at this point and just left the potatoes sitting in the pan, lid off and not on the burner that was hot. To put everything together I used about 1 tablespoon of butter in a 10" skillet over medium high heat and pan-fried the potatoes till they were Very brown and crispy, this will take awhile. While those are cooking, chop up a couple green onions, separating out the greens from the whites and cut the (leftover) steak into bite sized pieces. Once all the potatoes are cooked, add the white portion of the green onions and the steak, you're simply looking to warm the steak here, not cook it any further. Meanwhile do your over-easy eggs in another skillet.... Once the eggs are done, plate everything and garnish with the green part of the onions. Oh yeah, salt and pepper to taste.
